info.name: RightTouch API - Full (Customer + AuthZ verified)
info.description:
Base: /api/user (modules/identity/routes/User.js), /api/technician.
Envelope OK: {success:true,message,result} / Fail: {success:false,message,code,details}.
Rate limits: authLimiter 100/15m, otpLimiter 10/min, webhookLimiter 60/min, socket handshake 20/min/IP.
Auth header must be exactly `Bearer <JWT>` (HS256, payload {userId,role,technicianProfileId?,tokenVersion?,sid?}).
Refresh POST /api/user/auth/refresh is PUBLIC - NO Authorization header, body {refresh_token}. Rotation + reuse detection.
Socket.IO: io(host,{auth:{token}}). Webhooks: x-razorpay-signature HMAC fail-closed.
CORS exposed: x-new-token, x-rtb-fingerprint-id, request-id, x-request-id.
Verify-OTP tests auto-save {{customerToken}} + {{refreshToken}}.

item.name: 00 - Auth Customer OTP (phone only, no password)

request.description: PUBLIC authLimiter. Terms mandatory else 400 TERMS_OR_PRIVACY_NOT_ACCEPTED. Role Admin -> 403. OK 200 {identifier,role,purpose,expiresInSeconds}. Dup -> 409 MOBILE_ALREADY_EXISTS (use Login).

item.name: Signup customer - verify OTP (201 saves tokens)

request.description: Scoped Customer+SIGNUP. Latest verified:false unexpired OTP, >=5 attempts blocked, bcrypt compare. 201 {token,refresh_token,expires_in:3600,user,userId,role}.
PUBLIC authLimiter. OTP path for Customer. OK OTP_SENT {identifier,role,purpose:LOGIN,expiresInSeconds}. New number -> 404 USER_NOT_FOUND (go Signup). Blocked -> ACCOUNT_BLOCKED.
Generic. Forced variants inject role. Owner needs inviteCode.
PUBLIC otpLimiter 10/min. purpose SIGNUP|LOGIN optional. Cooldown -> 429 OTP_COOLDOWN. Set purpose=SIGNUP for signup flow.
Legacy generic. Prefer scoped twins above.

PUBLIC authLimiter. refresh_token>=32 chars (alias refreshToken accepted). One-time rotation, reuse -> family nuke + 401 REFRESH_INVALID. 200 {token,refresh_token,expires_in}. DO NOT send Authorization.
Auth (Bearer sid). Revokes that sid only, kills its sockets. Legacy no-sid -> {revoked:false}. 200 {revoked}.
Auth. Revokes all sessions + tokenVersion bump (kills all access) + kills all sockets. 200 {revokedCount}.
Auth self. Txn delete + purge sessions + kill sockets. 200 Account deleted successfully.
Auth. Customer: {fname,lname,gender,email} -> forces profileComplete:true. Technician variant needs address/city/state/pincode/lat/lng etc.
Auth. At least one true required.
Auth with verify-otp JWT. min 8 chars else 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.
Query ?search&categoryId&latitude&longitude. No location -> FULL + availabilityPrompt; with GPS -> zone-filtered.
Body varies by backend; adjust keys if 400.
NO Authorization. x-razorpay-signature HMAC verified fail-closed.
